description: SIP trade history. Retrieve all available trades for one date, in time order. → Returns {code, last_update, bar_type: '1T', series: [{time, close, volume, trade_id?, trade_exchange?, tape?, trade_conditions?}]}. Point time is Unix seconds with millisecond precision; last_update is Unix milliseconds. Empty results return series: [], error=data_unavailable, and message. Use filter to summarize trades or store=json with output_file to save the response.

date.description: Valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, using New York time (America/New_York, including daylight saving time). Today or one of the previous six dates.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: get_sip_trades
